translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Shaakkettanaw koyiyaa Asay bare amuwaa kaallee; lo"o era ubbaakka p'alk'k'ee.
Boozay bare k'ofaa k'onc'c'issanawaa s'alala dosiyaawaappe attina, hara asaappe era akkanaw dosenna.
Iitatetsay yiyaa wode, kad'ii, kawushshaynne yeellay Aa kaalliide yi aggiino.
Asaa doonaappe kesiyaa haasayay c'iimmo haatsaa mala; aad'd'eeda eratetsaa pulttuukka goggiyaa haatsaa mala.
Bayzzanchchaa maaddiide, s'illuwaa pirddaa geellayiyaawe lo"a gidenna.
Booza Asay bare haasayan walassaa dentsee; Aa doonaappe kesiyaa k'aalay Aa bolla s'am"aa s'eesee.
Booza asay, haasayiidde barena k'ohee; Aa haasayay gitiyaa gidiide, Aa oyk'k'ee.
Zigirssaa k'aalay mal"o k'umaa mala; nashechchiide duge ganjjiyaa gakkee.
Bare ootsiyaa oosuwaan azalliyaa Asay bayzziyaa uraappe ayinne dummatenna.
Med'inaa Godaa suntsay mino gimbbiyaa mala; s'illo Asay yaa wos's'iide saro attana.
Shin dure asatoo unttunttu duretetsay yuushshuu gimbbetteedda katamaa mala; unttunttu k'ofaan unttunttu duretetsay mino dirssaadan unttuntta naagiyaawaa malatee.
Asay kunddanaappe kase Aa wozanay otorettee; bonchchettiyaawaappekka bare huup'iyaa zik'k'i ootsiyaawe sintsatee.
Sisennan de'iiddi zaariyaawe, hewe he uraw boozatetsanne yeella.
Asaa ayyaanay harggiyaa danddayanaadan maaddee; shin ayyaanay me"eretti kichchooppe, Aa ooni danddayanee?
Akeekanchcha asatuu tamaaranaw loytsi koyiino; aad'd'eeda eray de'iyaawaakka hayzziino.
Immiyaawe immiyaawoo ogiyaa dooyee; wolk'k'aama asaanakka erissee.
Kasetiide daannan mootiyaa uray baaligaaray yiide Aa oochchana gakkanaw, ubbaa gedekka he uray s'illuwaa malatee.
Saamaa yeggiyaawe palumiyaa te"ee; laa"u wolk'k'aama baaligaaratuwaakka shaakkee.
Naak'etteedda ishay gimbbetteedda katamaappe aad'd'iide minnee; Aa palumiikka birataa gordduwaa mala.
Bare doonaan haasayeeddawaappe Asay bare ganjjiyaa kuntsee; bare ins's'arssaappe keseeddawaan kallee.
Neeni haasayeeddawe neena wotsee woy wod'ee; hewaa diraw, neeni ne haasayaa gaasuwaan yiyaawaa akkanaw de'aassa.
Machchato demmeedda Asay lo"obaa demmeedda; he uray Med'inaa Godaankka nashettee.
Hiyyeesaa Asay awuddashiide haasayee; shin durii peenuk'k'eetiide zaaree.
Daro laggii de'iyaa Asay d'ayana; shin ishaappe aad'd'iide ammantsiyaa laggii de'ee.
